note: User-facing picker. CLI prints this list; --subtitle-style <id> selects one. Pixel specs live in subtitlesguide.md. No id passed -> 'default' (never random). Each style is distinct on font + layout + motion, not just color.

styles.name: Amber Serif-Pop
styles.description: Bold white sans with one glowing amber italic-serif word per line. Build-up reveal, alternates top / mid-low. The trendy elegant look.
styles.distinct_by: two fonts (sans + glowing italic serif), build-up stack, zone alternation
styles.preview: WHITE bold + one *amber italic* glowing word

styles.name: Hormozi Classic
styles.description: Ultra-heavy Montserrat 900 ALL-CAPS, thick black stroke, active word highlights yellow as spoken. Fixed mid-low, centered. The benchmark business look — the boldest style.
styles.distinct_by: Montserrat 900 caps + 8px black stroke + active-word yellow highlight, fixed position
styles.preview: HEAVY WHITE CAPS, active word turns [YELLOW]

styles.name: Pill Box
styles.description: Each word sits in its own solid rounded pill; active word's pill turns the accent color. No stroke. Clean on any background. Fixed mid-low.
styles.distinct_by: per-word pill backgrounds (no stroke), active-pill color swap
styles.preview: words in [black pills], active word in [amber pill]

styles.name: Beat Bounce
styles.description: Tall condensed Bebas Neue, ONE giant word at a time dead-center, springy squash-stretch bounce per word. Max energy.
styles.distinct_by: one huge word at a time, center, spring squash-stretch motion
styles.preview: ONE BIG WORD bouncing in, center screen

styles.name: Karaoke Sweep
styles.description: Full phrase visible, dimmed; a color fill sweeps left-to-right across each word in time with speech. Calm, steady, readable. Fixed mid-low.
styles.distinct_by: full phrase shown, left-to-right color sweep tracks speech
styles.preview: dim phrase, color sweeps word by word
